outcome: Composite adverse neonatal outcomes (large for gestational age, shoulder dystocia or neonatal injury, respiratory distress, need for intravenous glucose treatment for hypoglycemia, or fetal or neonatal death)
Mechanical ventilation or continuous positive airway pressure
cohort: Pregnant individuals who underwent 2-step gestational diabetes mellitus screening at ≤30 weeks of gestation
finding: A cutoff of ≥10% time above target glucose range on continuous glucose monitoring was associated with a higher rate of neonatal adverse outcomes.
